All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
App
Entry point of the Library Book Management System.
Book
Represents a single book in the library.
BookStatus
Represents the possible status values of a book in the library.
Library
Manages the collection of books and contains all the business logic: adding, viewing, updating, deleting and changing the status of books.
LibraryException
Custom exception thrown when a library operation fails, for example because of invalid input, a duplicate ID or a book that does not exist.
LibraryGUI
Swing graphical user interface for the Library Book Management System.
LibraryGUI.BookCellRenderer
Draws table rows with stripes and shows the status in its own colour.
LibraryGUI.HeaderRenderer
Draws the table header cells with a dark background and white bold text.
